jobs.title: Lead, Office of Software Assurance
jobs.desc: Role Summary Â The Office of Software Assurance (OSA) Lead is the senior individual contributor who establishes and leads the Office of Software Assurance, a new shift-left software quality function inside the Agile Office, through technical expertise and influence rather than line management. The OSA embeds right-sized, risk-based assurance into a 1,000+ person Engineering organization, so that compliance evidence is produced as a natural, tool-native output of how teams build, not assembled after the fact. Â You will own day-to-day software quality execution across three lifecycle domains (SDLC, Computer Software Assurance, and Infrastructure Qualification). Nateraâs Software Quality Assurance department keeps independent oversight, approval authority, and the front-line role in audits and inspections. Your focus is faster, simpler, and compliant delivery, and you do it in a way you can defend to an auditor. The ideal candidate is a software engineer first, someone who understands code, CI/CD, and engineering tooling, and who has worked close enough to regulated environments to apply quality and regulatory expectations without becoming a bottleneck. Â What You Will Do Â Stand up the OSA and execute its charter in phases: Launch (engineering-tool assurance), Extend (product-software assurance planning and evidence-readiness review), and Mature (largely automated, tool-native release-readiness evidence, with SQA operating by exception). Own the OSA Charter and the OSA Responsibility Governance Matrix, and keep them current with SQA concurrence. Review annually or sooner as responsibilities phase in. Provide technical direction, coaching, and quality review for the OSA assurance resources, and contribute to their hiring and development plans in partnership with the Head of Agile Office. Coordinate, coach, and quality-check the engineers assigned the SQE capability within engineering teams. Define baselines and targets with the Sponsor and report on OSA success metrics: assurance turnaround and cycle time versus the legacy CSV path, deliverables per release versus the 8â10-per-release baseline, intake quality, SQA relief, inspection readiness, and capability milestones. Deliver right-sized assurance Oversee AL1âAL2 assurance planning and participate in AL3âAL4 assurance under the CSA SOP. This covers the path from CSA Intake through Software Assurance Plan, execution, report and closeout, and Service Catalog registration. Recommend the Assurance Level and assurance approach at CSA Intake. Select assurance activities and acceptance criteria from the Assurance Method Menu within an assigned level. Support SQA's level-confirmation walkthroughs. Drive a documented-critical-thinking culture. Teams should be able to explain their risk-based rationale to an auditor and apply the least-burdensome approach. Provide oversight, guidance, and continued standardization under the SDLC SOP and Infrastructure Qualification. Over time, provide product-software risk-classification input, assurance and verification planning, evidence-readiness review, and periodic review by Assurance Level. Â Govern engineering tools and change Own and execute the Engineering Tool Governance Work Instruction, from tool admission through retirement. Own and manage the Engineering Service Catalog, including registration of tools that hold regulated records. Oversee tool qualification. Provide fast-path change oversight and impact disposition on engineering tickets under the Software Change Work Instruction. Route device-software changes to SQA. Consult with Agile Office tooling administration on the assurance impact of tooling decisions. Â Partner with Software Quality Assurance (SQA) and the business Operate the inspection-readiness model: the OSA executes and supplies the technical narrative and tool-native evidence, while SQA approves determinations, plans, and closeouts and leads in audits and inspections. Maintain defined escalation triggers to SQA. Escalate unresolved scope or risk questions to the Sponsor and SQA leadership. Work with Product Managers and Lab Directors, who hold charter-level accountability for intended use and business need, so intended use is clearly communicated at intake and confirmed at delivery. Collaborate with the Security Team on lifecycle integration points (cybersecurity methodology stays with Security) and with Regulatory/QA on design-control boundaries. Â Build capability and automate Lead delivery of the SQE Upskilling Competency Development Plan across four tiers: regulatory and standards literacy, risk-based assurance and critical thinking, modern V V and tool-native evidence practices, and quality judgment. Provide compliant-SDLC coaching, process-feedback management, and training content. Source external training through bodies such as AAMI, ISPE, RAPS, and ASQ. Champion automation: embed evidence capture in the tools of record (for example, source control, ticketing, CI/CD, and test management), so evidence is cited by reference rather than assembled by hand. Â Required Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). 8+ years of software engineering experience, with hands-on development, test automation, DevOps, or engineering productivity work. You can read code and review pipelines, and you earn credibility with engineers. 4+ years working in or closely alongside a regulated environment, such as medical device, diagnostics, clinical laboratory, pharma or biotech, or another environment under design controls and a quality management system. Working knowledge of risk-based software assurance and validation concepts, such as FDA Computer Software Assurance (CSA) guidance, computer system validation, or software verification and validation. Practical familiarity with several of: IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, 21 CFR Part 820 / QMSR, 21 CFR Part 11, IEC 81001-5-1, AAMI TIR45. 3+ years of technical leadership experience, such as leading cross-functional programs through influence and mentoring engineers, and experience building or scaling a process or function. People management experience is a plus but not required. Demonstrated ability to partner with an independent quality function and to hold a clear line between execution and independent oversight. Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain a risk rationale to engineers, executives, and auditors. Â Preferred Direct experience supporting or hosting FDA, notified-body, CAP, CLIA, or ISO audits and inspections. Experience with AI, agile at scale, engineering tool governance, or tool qualification. Experience with GAMP 5, SaaS or cloud-tool qualification, or infrastructure qualification for software and cloud platforms. Experience automating compliance evidence in tools such as Jira and Jama, source control, CI/CD, and test management platforms. Experience in clinical diagnostics, genomics, or lab informatics software. Certifications such as ASQ CSQE, CQA, or RAPS RAC. Experience designing competency or upskilling programs for engineers. The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations. Remote USA $139,300 â $174,150 USD OUR OPPORTUNITY Nateraâ¢ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, womenâs health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives. The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, youâll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, youâll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management. WHAT WE OFFER Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program! jobs.title: Manager, Engineering - Identity
jobs.desc: Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About the Role: An extensible, integration-ready enterprise-grade IAM solution is integral to Camunda’s long-term strategy. As our next Engineering Manager for Identity, you’ll lead the team that builds and delivers the Identity and Access Management (IAM) foundation that powers the entire Camunda 8 platform, both on-premise and as part of our SaaS offering. This is a key role which can have a deep impact on Camunda’s success, offering you the chance to have a direct impact on the company’s growth. As engineering manager, you will be tasked with end-to-end delivery of said solutions, and work closely with other engineering teams to ensure they are well integrated across the entire stack, making it secure, enterprise-ready, and easy to integrate at scale. You will coach and grow your team in order to deliver a high quality product within a predictable timeframe. At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, design, QA, and sales, and work with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence the evolution of our platform to meet our customer’s needs. What You Will Do: Own end-to-end delivery of reusable IAM components across the Camunda 8 stack—shaping authentication (multi‑protocol), authorization (RBAC), and federated organization management that work seamlessly for large, integration‑heavy enterprises. Partner closely with multiple engineering teams, SREs, QA, and the Product Leadership Team to develop and drive a clear technical and product vision; transparently steward the roadmap and track commitments from support, incidents, and the product backlog. Raise the bar on reliability and efficiency: keep build/release pipelines low‑effort and stable, ship security fixes within SLOs, and drive down support load, bug count, and incident rate. Grow and coach a team of senior and developing engineers—setting clear expectations, giving actionable feedback, and creating a culture of autonomy, accountability, and continuous improvement, especially in an asynchronous, remote environment aligned to the DRI model. Help mature our SaaS offering for large scale enterprise customers, ensuring it can easily integrate with our customer’s own IAM solutions in a safe, reliable way. What You Will Bring to the Role: Must Haves: Senior‑level technical depth in IAM and enterprise software: you can review designs, ask the right questions, and represent your team to technical and non‑technical stakeholders with clarity. Proven track record leading medium‑to‑large delivery: you have owned 6‑month‑scale projects from inception to release, guiding 3–5+ engineers, writing solution designs and project plans, and delivering on time without micromanagement in a remote, asynchronous setting. Hands-on experience either implementing or integrating IAM solutions; you understand protocols like OIDC and SAML and how they work in complex enterprise environments. Strong communication and stakeholder management: you translate business requirements into actionable engineering plans, can speak with customers when needed, and drive decisive, low‑churn outcomes. Background in product engineering for integration‑heavy B2B products (not primarily consulting), with a deep appreciation for enterprise needs around security, operability, and performance. Ability and/or willingness to use our product . Nice to Haves: Experience with workflow orchestration platforms or similar distributed systems. Familiarity with Spring Security and the broader Spring ecosystem. Experience implementing IAM federation. Experience with clustered/distributed, eventually consistent applications. Experience with L3 support/incident management. Experience working in a fully remote organization. This role is an existing vacancy #LI-SG1 #LI-Remote #USEAST #C1 What We Have to Offer: Compensation We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition. The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills , experience , and location , and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth: United States: $172,600.00 to $278,300.00 United Kingdom: £108,400.00 to £178,300.00 Singapore: S$214,400.00 to S$321,500.00 Canada: C$183,300 to C$301,500 If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview. Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP) . Benefits Perks We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable. Remote Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it. Working closely with various Finance teams and business stakeholders, you will help strengthen financial processes and internal controls.
